purpose: Compare native Codex, Pi, and OpenCode on one reachable, byte-identical OpenSpec implementation task; this single pilot is not a general harness ranking.
v1_protocol_corrections: Allow tests/artifacts/test_research_probe_admission.py so the existing intentional export contract can change with the approved public facade.
Remove the unrelated baseline-red research-vocabulary residue suite from this change's hard gate.

baseline_preflight.command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=-1 conda run -n ms pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/artifacts/test_evidence_journal.py tests/artifacts/test_research_probe_admission.py
baseline_preflight.meaning: Every pre-existing test included in the final acceptance suite is green before implementation.

excluded_baseline_failure.reason: It scans the research-probe admission owner for vocabulary that the existing owner already binds and is unrelated to the authorized facade, composition tests, and guide change.

frozen_prompt.launcher_envelope_rule: The task payload is byte-identical. A native launcher envelope may add only the assigned worktree path because native spawn has no target_worktree field.

launch_policy.spawn_gate: Start the next route only after the prior spawn is accepted; stop immediately on a spawn failure.
launch_policy.execution: Agents run concurrently after admission; do not wait for implementation completion during launch.

evaluation.secondary: lead acceptance after at most one bounded correction
hard_gates: no write outside the authorized surface
evaluation.missing_usage_policy: Mark unavailable provider fields unknown; never infer them with a tokenizer.

seed_identity_policy: At launch, all three worktree trees must be byte-identical, each status must be clean, and the frozen prompt and OpenSpec hashes must match this manifest.
